facts.summary: Enrollment stopped after futility analysis showed no benefit · Phase 2 · tamibarotene triplet in newly diagnosed unfit AML · not yet approved
facts.indication: acute myeloid leukemia (AML) with RARA overexpression

evidence.summary: will discontinue enrollment in the SELECT-AML-1 Phase 2 clinical trial evaluating the triplet regimen of tamibarotene in combination with venetoclax and azacitidine
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: A similar complete response (CR)/complete response with incomplete hematologic recovery (CRi) rate was observed in the triplet arm (n=20; 65%, CI: 40.8-84.6) and the doublet arm (n=20; 70%, CI: 45.7-88.1).
evidence.safety: There were no new safety signals associated with the use of tamibarotene in combination with venetoclax and azacitidine.
evidence.program_discontinued: will discontinue enrollment in the SELECT-AML-1 Phase 2 clinical trial
